source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: Unique IB identity; paired OOB case confirms App 0x06/0x54 read and pagination semantics.

source_snapshot.procedure: Run raw App 0x06/0x54 for a selected channel/list index both in-band and out-of-band; 0x80 lists by cipher suite and 0x00 lists supported algorithms; generic pre-step clears logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: Command should be sent without any error.

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: requires exact bytes and expected output

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: FULLY AUTOMATABLE after target-firmware parser, pagination and policy normalization.
historical_reviews.related_source_cases: OOB counterpart independently confirms read-only 0x54 semantics.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-34 makes target/channel/reference Project inputs; ED-38 no retry.

original_test_intent: Inventory and decode the cipher suites or algorithms advertised on an approved BMC channel over the required IB and OOB paths without changing channel security.
original_method: Use protected App 0x06/0x54 for the approved channel, selector and list indices, paginate completely, decode identifiers and compare the security policy.
manual_activity: Security owner supplies the channel/mode/index matrix and approved cipher policy once; reads need no point-of-action confirmation.
safety_requirements: Fail closed on unknown IDs or pagination
agent_execution_scope: Compare policy and return redacted evidence

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Understates executability; the source already supplies 0x54 and selectors, while the missing parser/reference are Project inputs.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Protected ipmitool raw 0x06 0x54 with explicit channel/mode/index and versioned parser; use secret-safe OOB transport.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Original command, modes and 10/5 timing preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Collect all required 0x54 pages via IB and OOB, validate framing/end-of-list, normalize every suite/algorithm ID and compare the approved security baseline without remediation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete parsing, policy criteria and safe credential handling while retaining both transports.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Advertised capability only; it does not prove negotiation or modify suites.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw success alone can hide truncated pages or weak/unknown algorithms.

project_override_considerations: High-level readers may substitute only if they preserve both required path coverage, complete identifiers and pagination evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Title says IB but Procedure requires IB and OOB; Criteria accepts mere command success, omits decoding/policy, uses unsafe -P credentials and asks to clear logs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The exact read command is present; parser, channel and policy are Project readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes both transports, pagination and security-policy comparison independently measurable instead of accepting a zero completion code.
independent_technical_reasoning: 0x54 is read-only and deterministic. Once the list matrix and parser are supplied, both transport collections and policy comparison can be automated without state changes, so FULLY AUTOMATABLE is appropriate.
